steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Hmm... Did they really do it like this?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Wait, no... that's not it. Maybe it was more of a quick whoosh over here? Hmm... still doesn't look right...
Inside the temporary Command HQ, you find Wynn wearing a device like VR goggles. Her head bobs and sways as she manipulates a holographic control panel floating before her.
At the sound of your voice, Wynn jumps in surprise.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Ch-Chief?! When did you—I didn't even hear you come in...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Let me reset the view—whoa, my head's spinning...
She fumbles to tap the device on her head. With a soft beep, the holographic screen dissolves. You stare at the odd contraption in Wynn's hands, wondering what it could be.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: It just arrived. Called the "Scenario Sync Simulator." Um... how'd the manual put it...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Right! It can compile all our intel, surveillance clips, and witness accounts into a replayable scene!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: And if you put this on, you can experience exactly what happened!
Probably yet another creation from one of MBCC's resident geniuses.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: ...I was trying to recreate how those phantom thieves broke into the gallery.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: But my moves were way off... Triggered the alarms so many times, my ears are still buzzing.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: You should try it, Chief! You'd totally nail it.
Eagerly, Wynn passes you the device, and you turn it over in your hands. Its exterior is generic, nearly identical to any household VR set on the market.
Appearances can be deceiving, you think, and with that silent rationale, you place it on your head as she watches, barely containing her anticipation.
